summary_1line: Upamanyu begins reciting and explaining the sacred thousand names of Mahadeva, praising Shiva as the supreme, all-encompassing cosmic reality.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Upamanyu stands with folded hands before Krishna and Yudhishthira, solemnly beginning the recitation of the thousand names of Mahadeva.
Shiva with blue throat and matted locks holds trident, bow, skull, and thunderbolt while the universe appears as his vast cosmic body.
The river Ganga descends from heaven and becomes caught in the tangled matted hair of Shiva before flowing down to earth.
